prompts.prompt: Use the supplied image ONLY as visual style and costume reference. Create ONE production sprite animation atlas on true transparent background, crisp detailed chibi pixel art with dark brown outlines and 2.4 head proportions, matching Ayothaya Folk Mystic. Exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, landscape 2:1 image. Eight isolated full-body sprites in exactly aligned equal square cells, no borders, no text, no ground or shadows. Top row same adult male, bottom row same adult female. Each cell: identical head size, outfit and equipment identity, soles baseline at 90% of cell height, body centered, complete weapons contained, 10% clear padding. All face 3/4 toward viewer's right. Columns left to right: 1 relaxed alert idle; 2 walking with left foot forward and right foot back, swinging arms; 3 walking with right foot forward and left foot back, swinging arms opposite; 4 distinct dynamic action pose described below. Walk poses must show clearly different leg and arm positions, not copies or merely shifted bodies. Consistent facial identity across each row. No duplicated extra figures, no smooth vector, no realistic rendering. Preserve finely clustered pixel texture. Character specification: Thai swordsman / swordswoman, indigo lamellar tunic with small gold trim, red sash, Thai curved single sword and round shield. Attack pose slashes the sword out to the side with a bent front knee.
